10.web: For you need endurance so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.
10.kjv: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.
10.bsb: You need to persevere, so that after you have done the will of God, you will receive what He has promised.

10.web: “In a very little while, he who comes will come, and will not wait.
10.kjv: For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.
10.bsb: For, “In just a little while, He who is coming will come and will not delay.

10.web: But the righteous will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him.”
10.kjv: Now the just shall live by faith: but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.
10.bsb: But My righteous one will live by faith; and if he shrinks back, I will take no pleasure in him.”

10.web: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.
10.kjv: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.
10.bsb: But we are not of those who shrink back and are destroyed, but of those who have faith and preserve their souls.

11.web: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.
11.kjv: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
11.bsb: Now faith is the assurance of what we hope for and the certainty of what we do not see.

11.web: For by this, the elders obtained testimony.
11.kjv: For by it the elders obtained a good report.
11.bsb: This is why the ancients were commended.

11.web: By faith, we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.
11.kjv: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.
11.bsb: By faith we understand that the universe was formed at God’s command, so that what is seen was not made out of what was visible.

11.web: By faith, Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.
11.kjv: By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh.
11.bsb: By faith Abel offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did. By faith he was commended as righteous when God gave approval to his gifts. And by faith he still speaks, even though he is dead.

11.web: By faith, Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn’t see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.
11.kjv: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because God had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased God.
11.bsb: By faith Enoch was taken up so that he did not see death: “He could not be found, because God had taken him away.” For before he was taken, he was commended as one who pleased God.

11.web: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.
11.kjv: But without faith it is impossible to please him : for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
11.bsb: And without faith it is impossible to please God, because anyone who approaches Him must believe that He exists and that He rewards those who earnestly seek Him.

11.web: By faith, Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.
11.kjv: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.
11.bsb: By faith Noah, when warned about things not yet seen, in godly fear built an ark to save his family. By faith he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness that comes by faith.

11.web: By faith, Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.
11.kjv: By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.
11.bsb: By faith Abraham, when called to go to a place he would later receive as his inheritance, obeyed and went, without knowing where he was going.

11.web: By faith, he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents, with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.
11.kjv: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as in a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:
11.bsb: By faith he dwelt in the promised land as a stranger in a foreign country. He lived in tents, as did Isaac and Jacob, who were heirs with him of the same promise.

11.web: For he looked for the city which has the foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
11.kjv: For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
11.bsb: For he was looking forward to the city with foundations, whose architect and builder is God.

11.web: By faith, even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.
11.kjv: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed, and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged him faithful who had promised.
11.bsb: By faith Sarah, even though she was barren and beyond the proper age, was enabled to conceive a child, because she considered Him faithful who had promised.

11.web: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.
11.kjv: Therefore sprang there even of one, and him as good as dead, so many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable.
11.bsb: And so from one man, and he as good as dead, came descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and as countless as the sand on the seashore.

11.web: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and embraced them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
11.kjv: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of them , and embraced them , and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
11.bsb: All these people died in faith, without having received the things they were promised. However, they saw them and welcomed them from afar. And they acknowledged that they were strangers and exiles on the earth.

11.web: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.
11.kjv: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.
11.bsb: Now those who say such things show that they are seeking a country of their own.

11.web: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.
11.kjv: And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.
11.bsb: If they had been thinking of the country they had left, they would have had opportunity to return.

11.web: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.
11.kjv: But now they desire a better country , that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.
11.bsb: Instead, they were longing for a better country, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed to be called their God, for He has prepared a city for them.

11.web: By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his one and only son,
11.kjv: By faith Abraham, when he was tried, offered up Isaac: and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten son ,
11.bsb: By faith Abraham, when he was tested, offered up Isaac on the altar. He who had received the promises was ready to offer his one and only son,

11.web: to whom it was said, “your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac”;
11.kjv: Of whom it was said, That in Isaac shall thy seed be called:
11.bsb: even though God had said to him, “Through Isaac your offspring will be reckoned.”

11.web: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.
11.kjv: Accounting that God was able to raise him up, even from the dead; from whence also he received him in a figure.
11.bsb: Abraham reasoned that God could raise the dead, and in a sense, he did receive Isaac back from death.

11.web: By faith, Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.
11.kjv: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.
11.bsb: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning the future.

11.web: By faith, Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.
11.kjv: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, leaning upon the top of his staff.
11.bsb: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of Joseph’s sons and worshiped as he leaned on the top of his staff.

11.web: By faith, Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel; and gave instructions concerning his bones.
11.kjv: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.
11.bsb: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, spoke about the exodus of the Israelites and gave instructions about his bones.

11.web: By faith, Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.
11.kjv: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw he was a proper child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.
11.bsb: By faith Moses’ parents hid him for three months after his birth, because they saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were unafraid of the king’s edict.

11.web: By faith, Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,
11.kjv: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter;
11.bsb: By faith Moses, when he was grown, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter.

11.web: choosing rather to share ill treatment with God’s people, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time;
11.kjv: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;
11.bsb: He chose to suffer oppression with God’s people rather than to experience the fleeting enjoyment of sin.

11.web: accounting the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.
11.kjv: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.
11.bsb: He valued disgrace for Christ above the treasures of Egypt, for he was looking ahead to his reward.

11.web: By faith, he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
11.kjv: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
11.bsb: By faith Moses left Egypt, not fearing the king’s anger; he persevered because he saw Him who is invisible.

11.web: By faith, he kept the Passover, and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.
11.kjv: Through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.
11.bsb: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of blood, so that the destroyer of the firstborn would not touch Israel’s own firstborn.

11.web: By faith, they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.
11.kjv: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land : which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.
11.bsb: By faith the people passed through the Red Sea as on dry land; but when the Egyptians tried to follow, they were drowned.

11.web: By faith, the walls of Jericho fell down, after they had been encircled for seven days.
11.kjv: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.
11.bsb: By faith the walls of Jericho fell, after the people had marched around them for seven days.

11.web: By faith, Rahab the prostitute, didn’t perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.
11.kjv: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not, when she had received the spies with peace.
11.bsb: By faith the prostitute Rahab, because she welcomed the spies in peace, did not perish with those who were disobedient.

11.web: What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets;
11.kjv: And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and of Barak, and of Samson, and of Jephthae; of David also, and Samuel, and of the prophets:
11.bsb: And what more shall I say? Time will not allow me to tell of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets,

11.web: who, through faith subdued kingdoms, worked out righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
11.kjv: Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
11.bsb: who through faith conquered kingdoms, administered justice, and gained what was promised; who shut the mouths of lions,

11.web: quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, from weakness were made strong, grew mighty in war, and caused foreign armies to flee.
11.kjv: Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, waxed valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.
11.bsb: quenched the raging fire, and escaped the edge of the sword; who gained strength from weakness, became mighty in battle, and put foreign armies to flight.

11.web: Women received their dead by resurrection. Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.
11.kjv: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:
11.bsb: Women received back their dead, raised to life again. Others were tortured and refused their release, so that they might gain a better resurrection.

11.web: Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.
11.kjv: And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:
11.bsb: Still others endured mocking and flogging, and even chains and imprisonment.

11.web: They were stoned. They were sawn apart. They were tempted. They were slain with the sword. They went around in sheep skins and in goat skins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated
11.kjv: They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;
11.bsb: They were stoned, they were sawed in two, they were put to death by the sword. They went around in sheepskins and goatskins, destitute, oppressed, and mistreated.

11.web: (of whom the world was not worthy), wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.
11.kjv: (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.
11.bsb: The world was not worthy of them. They wandered in deserts and mountains, and hid in caves and holes in the ground.

11.web: These all, having had testimony given to them through their faith, didn’t receive the promise,
11.kjv: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:
11.bsb: These were all commended for their faith, yet they did not receive what was promised.

11.web: God having provided some better thing concerning us, so that apart from us they should not be made perfect.
11.kjv: God having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.
11.bsb: God had planned something better for us, so that together with us they would be made perfect.

12.web: Therefore let us also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let us run with perseverance the race that is set before us,
12.kjv: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us , and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
12.bsb: Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off every encumbrance and the sin that so easily entangles, and let us run with endurance the race set out for us.

12.web: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
12.kjv: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
12.bsb: Let us fix our eyes on Jesus, the author and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy set before Him endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

12.web: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in your souls.
12.kjv: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.
12.bsb: Consider Him who endured such hostility from sinners, so that you will not grow weary and lose heart.

12.web: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin;
12.kjv: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.
12.bsb: In your struggle against sin, you have not yet resisted to the point of shedding your blood.

12.web: and you have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are reproved by him;
12.kjv: And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children, My son, despise not thou the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when thou art rebuked of him:
12.bsb: And you have forgotten the exhortation that addresses you as sons: “My son, do not take lightly the discipline of the Lord, and do not lose heart when He rebukes you.

12.web: For whom the Lord loves, he chastens, and scourges every son whom he receives.”
12.kjv: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.
12.bsb: For the Lord disciplines the one He loves, and He chastises every son He receives.”

12.web: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father doesn’t discipline?
12.kjv: If ye endure chastening, God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not?
12.bsb: Endure suffering as discipline; God is treating you as sons. For what son is not disciplined by his father?

12.web: But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then are you illegitimate, and not children.
12.kjv: But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.
12.bsb: If you do not experience discipline like everyone else, then you are illegitimate children and not true sons.

12.web: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits, and live?
12.kjv: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us , and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?
12.bsb: Furthermore, we have all had earthly fathers who disciplined us, and we respected them. Should we not much more submit to the Father of our spirits and live?

12.web: For they indeed, for a few days, punished us as seemed good to them; but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.
12.kjv: For they verily for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure; but he for our profit, that we might be partakers of his holiness.
12.bsb: Our fathers disciplined us for a short time as they thought best, but God disciplines us for our good, so that we may share in His holiness.

12.web: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been exercised thereby.
12.kjv: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.
12.bsb: No discipline seems enjoyable at the time, but painful. Later on, however, it yields a harvest of righteousness and peace to those who have been trained by it.

12.web: Therefore lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees,
12.kjv: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;
12.bsb: Therefore strengthen your limp hands and weak knees.

12.web: and make straight paths for your feet, so what is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.
12.kjv: And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.
12.bsb: Make straight paths for your feet, so that the lame may not be disabled, but rather healed.

12.web: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,
12.kjv: Follow peace with all men , and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:
12.bsb: Pursue peace with everyone, as well as holiness, without which no one will see the Lord.

12.web: looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and many be defiled by it;
12.kjv: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you , and thereby many be defiled;
12.bsb: See to it that no one falls short of the grace of God, and that no root of bitterness springs up to cause trouble and defile many.

12.web: lest there be any sexually immoral person, or profane person, like Esau, who sold his birthright for one meal.
12.kjv: Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.
12.bsb: See to it that no one is sexually immoral, or is godless like Esau, who for a single meal sold his birthright.

12.web: For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears.
12.kjv: For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.
12.bsb: For you know that afterward, when he wanted to inherit the blessing, he was rejected. He could find no ground for repentance, though he sought the blessing with tears.

12.web: For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched, and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,
12.kjv: For ye are not come unto the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,
12.bsb: For you have not come to a mountain that can be touched and that is burning with fire; to darkness, gloom, and storm;

12.web: the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which those who heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken to them,
12.kjv: And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which voice they that heard intreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:
12.bsb: to a trumpet blast or to a voice that made its hearers beg that no further word be spoken.

12.web: for they could not stand that which was commanded, “If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned”;
12.kjv: (For they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with a dart:
12.bsb: For they could not bear what was commanded: “If even an animal touches the mountain, it must be stoned.”

12.web: and so fearful was the appearance that Moses said, “I am terrified and trembling.”
12.kjv: And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)
12.bsb: The sight was so terrifying that even Moses said, “I am trembling with fear.”

12.web: But you have come to Mount Zion, and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable multitudes of angels,
12.kjv: But ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,
12.bsb: Instead, you have come to Mount Zion, to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem. You have come to myriads of angels

12.web: to the festal gathering and assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of just men made perfect,
12.kjv: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,
12.bsb: in joyful assembly, to the congregation of the firstborn, enrolled in heaven. You have come to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of the righteous made perfect,

12.web: to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.
12.kjv: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel.
12.bsb: to Jesus the mediator of a new covenant, and to the sprinkled blood that speaks a better word than the blood of Abel.

12.web: See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,
12.kjv: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more shall not we escape , if we turn away from him that speaketh from heaven:
12.bsb: See to it that you do not refuse Him who speaks. For if the people did not escape when they refused Him who warned them on earth, how much less will we escape if we reject Him who warns us from heaven?

12.web: whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens.”
12.kjv: Whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven.
12.bsb: At that time His voice shook the earth, but now He has promised, “Once more I will shake not only the earth, but heaven as well.”

12.web: This phrase, “Yet once more”, signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.
12.kjv: And this word , Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.
12.bsb: The words “Once more” signify the removal of what can be shaken—that is, created things—so that the unshakable may remain.

12.web: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let us have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,
12.kjv: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:
12.bsb: Therefore, since we are receiving an unshakable kingdom, let us be filled with gratitude, and so worship God acceptably with reverence and awe.

12.web: for our God is a consuming fire.
12.kjv: For our God is a consuming fire.
12.bsb: “For our God is a consuming fire.”

13.web: Let brotherly love continue.
13.kjv: Let brotherly love continue.
13.bsb: Continue in brotherly love.

13.web: Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.
13.kjv: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.
13.bsb: Do not neglect to show hospitality to strangers, for by so doing some people have entertained angels without knowing it.

13.web: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them; and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.
13.kjv: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.
13.bsb: Remember those in prison as if you were bound with them, and those who are mistreated as if you were suffering with them.

13.web: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled: but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
13.kjv: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.
13.bsb: Marriage should be honored by all and the marriage bed kept undefiled, for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.

13.web: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”
13.kjv: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.
13.bsb: Keep your lives free from the love of money and be content with what you have, for God has said: “Never will I leave you, never will I forsake you.”

13.web: So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”
13.kjv: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.
13.bsb: So we say with confidence: “The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?”

13.web: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.
13.kjv: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.
13.bsb: Remember your leaders who spoke the word of God to you. Consider the outcome of their way of life and imitate their faith.

13.web: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
13.kjv: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.
13.bsb: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.

13.web: Don’t be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by food, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.
13.kjv: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines. For it is a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied therein.
13.bsb: Do not be carried away by all kinds of strange teachings, for it is good for the heart to be strengthened by grace and not by foods of no value to those devoted to them.

13.web: We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.
13.kjv: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle.
13.bsb: We have an altar from which those who serve at the tabernacle have no right to eat.

13.web: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp.
13.kjv: For the bodies of those beasts, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned without the camp.
13.bsb: Although the high priest brings the blood of animals into the Holy Place as a sacrifice for sin, the bodies are burned outside the camp.

13.web: Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.
13.kjv: Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people with his own blood, suffered without the gate.
13.bsb: And so Jesus also suffered outside the city gate, to sanctify the people by His own blood.

13.web: Let us therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.
13.kjv: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.
13.bsb: Therefore let us go to Him outside the camp, bearing the disgrace He bore.

13.web: For we don’t have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.
13.kjv: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.
13.bsb: For here we do not have a permanent city, but we are looking for the city that is to come.

13.web: Through him, then, let us offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.
13.kjv: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.
13.bsb: Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise, the fruit of lips that confess His name.

13.web: But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
13.kjv: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
13.bsb: And do not neglect to do good and to share with others, for with such sacrifices God is pleased.

13.web: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they may do this with joy, and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.
13.kjv: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that is unprofitable for you.
13.bsb: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch over your souls as those who must give an account. To this end, allow them to lead with joy and not with grief, for that would be of no advantage to you.

13.web: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.
13.kjv: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.
13.bsb: Pray for us; we are convinced that we have a clear conscience and desire to live honorably in every way.

13.web: I strongly urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you sooner.
13.kjv: But I beseech you the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.
13.bsb: And I especially urge you to pray that I may be restored to you soon.

13.web: Now may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus,
13.kjv: Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,
13.bsb: Now may the God of peace, who through the blood of the eternal covenant brought back from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great Shepherd of the sheep,

13.web: make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
13.kjv: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
13.bsb: equip you with every good thing to do His will. And may He accomplish in us what is pleasing in His sight through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen.

13.web: But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation; for I have written to you in few words.
13.kjv: And I beseech you, brethren, suffer the word of exhortation: for I have written a letter unto you in few words.
13.bsb: I urge you, brothers, to bear with my word of exhortation, for I have only written to you briefly.

13.web: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.
13.kjv: Know ye that our brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.
13.bsb: Be aware that our brother Timothy has been released. If he arrives soon, I will come with him to see you.

13.web: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. The Italians greet you.
13.kjv: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.
13.bsb: Greet all your leaders and all the saints. Those from Italy send you greetings.

13.web: Grace be with you all. Amen.
13.kjv: Grace be with you all. Amen.
13.bsb: Grace be with all of you.
